12% of remote listings now require AI skills.

Our latest snapshot of 3,928 remote jobs shows 487 explicitly list AI as a requirement. That's a growing share, but it still trails communication (41%) and sits just ahead of leadership (11%).

Top pay example: Jabil lists a Sr. Principal Product Engineer at USD 132,400–238,400 per year with AI-adjacent cloud expertise. But only 22% of listings disclose salary, so many high-paying roles hide pay.

AI appears across roles—from engineering to people ops to sales. Even non-technical roles like Live Ops Manager list it as a nice-to-have.

Should you double down on AI skills? It's a differentiator, but not a guaranteed premium. Companies still prioritize communication and domain expertise.
